titre: Authorization for a child to leave the country (AST)
resume: When your child travels abroad without either parent (Mauritius, Madagascar, or a flight to mainland France with a stopover abroad): the free form, the documents, and what to do if you fear a departure without your consent.
aQuoiCaSert: The authorization to leave the country (autorisation de sortie du territoire, AST) allows a minor who lives in France to travel abroad without a parent or a person with parental authority: school trip, stay with a relative, holiday camp. It is filled in without going to the town hall or the préfecture. From Réunion, a stay in Mauritius, Madagascar or the Seychelles means leaving French territory. A journey between mainland France and Réunion with a stopover abroad also requires an AST if the child travels without their parents.
quiEstConcerne: Minors who live in France and travel abroad without any parent or holder of parental authority (alone, with a group, a relative or another adult).
Separated parents who need to sign or check an AST, or who fear the child will be taken abroad without their consent.
aSavoir: No AST is needed if the child travels with one of their parents, even if the parents are separated.

One parent holding parental authority is enough to sign. The other parent's consent is not required, but it is advisable to avoid conflicts. If a judgment gives parental authority to one parent only, only that parent signs.
The period of validity is chosen by the signing parent, up to a maximum of one year: a single trip or a longer period.
The form is free and is filled in online on service-public.gouv.fr, or printed and completed by hand. No trip to an office is needed.
Flight between mainland France and Réunion (or another overseas department) with a stopover abroad: the AST is needed if the child travels without their parents.

The child must have their own valid ID (ID card or passport depending on the country), and a visa if the country requires one. The family record book (livret de famille) cannot be required, but a copy avoids misunderstandings.
An AST does not allow the child to leave if they are subject to an opposition to leaving the country (OST) or a ban on leaving the country (IST).

Fear of imminent abduction: an opposition de sortie du territoire (OST) is requested in person at the préfecture or a sous-préfecture (at the police station or gendarmerie if they are closed and departure is imminent). It lasts 15 days at most, with no extension. For a lasting measure, an interdiction de sortie du territoire (IST) can be ordered by the family court judge (juge aux affaires familiales, JAF) (or, depending on the case, by the public prosecutor or the juvenile court judge).

IST in force: the child can only leave the country with both parents' consent, declared by each of them, together or separately, at a police station or gendarmerie at least 5 days before departure. If they disagree, only the family court judge can suspend the IST. A flight to mainland France with a stopover abroad also requires this suspension.

documents.detail: Original signed by one parent holding parental authority, filled in online on service-public.gouv.fr then printed. The child keeps it on them during the trip.

documents.libelle: Legible photocopy of the signing parent's ID
documents.detail: French parent: ID card or passport, valid or expired less than 5 years ago. Parent from outside the European Union: valid passport and valid French residence permit.
ID card or passport depending on the destination, with a visa if the country requires one. If it has expired, see the guide entry "Getting my child's ID card or passport".

documents.libelle: Copy of the family record book
documents.detail: Cannot be required, but recommended if the child and the signing parent have different surnames.
Useful if you hold parental authority alone or in case of an IST. Essential for an OST, together with any evidence of the risk (plane ticket, messages).

etapes.titre: Check whether an AST is needed
etapes.detail: Is the child going abroad, or taking a flight with a stopover abroad, without either parent? If so, an AST is required. If the child travels with one of you, it is not needed. A trip to Mayotte or mainland France on a direct flight does not mean leaving the country.
On service-public.gouv.fr. Enter the period of validity (one year at most), then print and sign.

Original signed form, legible photocopy of the signing parent's ID, the child's valid ID (and visa if needed), copy of the family record book. Ask the airline or the organizer about their own requirements.

etapes.titre: Hand everything to the child or the accompanying adult
etapes.detail: The documents travel with the child. Keep a copy in the Vault.

etapes.titre: If you fear a departure without your consent
etapes.detail: Emergency: go in person to the préfecture de La Réunion or a sous-préfecture with the form, proof of parental authority, your ID and proof of address, the child's ID and evidence of the risk. For lasting protection, apply to the family court judge.

ou.nom: Préfecture de La Réunion (Saint-Denis) or the sous-préfecture for your area (State administration offices)
ou.detail: Only for an emergency opposition to leaving the country (OST). Police station or gendarmerie if they are closed and departure is imminent.
Free information on your rights, without access to individual files.
